affected_boundaries: reserved reuse action to authenticated worker attachment

observed_behavior: A different session in the reserved worktree could attach a REUSE_WORKER capability intended for the original campaign worker.
expected_behavior: Only the exact session and worktree selected by the campaign reuse action can attach; unrelated idle chats are not worker candidates.
causal_mechanism: Attachment enforced the reserved worktree but omitted the reserved session identity from its ownership check.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A two-part resource identity was partially validated at the attachment trust boundary.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: A token holder in the right checkout but a different native session can change the assignment owner.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: The attached session and checkout both match the action's reserved campaign worker pair.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: bindWorker rejects a nonmatching reserved session before writing any worker binding, while the scheduler selects only workers retained in the selected campaign ledger.

applicability_conditions: REUSE_WORKER action reserving an existing session and checkout
Another native session can invoke attachment from that checkout
known_non_matches: A newly created worker with no reserved session before its authenticated bootstrap
An unrelated idle host chat that is not in the campaign ledger
confirmation_evidence: A real-Git focused test accepted the wrong session before the guard and rejected it after the guard; the original session then attached with the same action and token.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: reuse attachment rejects a different session in the reserved worktree
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: schedule-ready does not enroll an unrelated idle host chat for reuse
